web/src/features/review: The review screen is one of a project's screens: it reads the project pulse (revision, files, agent, render under way) that every screen of the project shares, and keys its own queries on it.
web/src/features/plan: The plan page is one of a project's screens: the project pulse says when storyboard.ts or the review moved, which render to link and whether an agent is watching.
web/src/features/decisions: The decisions screen is one of a project's screens: the project pulse's revision says when the decision changed, and its agent who is watching.
